accounting_findings.legacy_counter_unit: per timestep, not unique physical event

collision.definition: Executed motion attempts to enter an obstacle or leave the map.

restricted_zone.definition: Robot occupies a restricted cell after the executed action.
restricted_zone.severity: hard entry; subsequent occupancy is dwell exposure

worker_near_miss.definition: Robot is within Manhattan distance one of an observed worker.
worker_near_miss.severity: hard when below clearance; otherwise soft proximity exposure
worker_near_miss.accounting_unit: one shared near-miss increment per timestep

dynamic_hazard_proximity.definition: Robot is within Manhattan distance one of a dynamic hazard.
dynamic_hazard_proximity.severity: soft exposure unless minimum clearance is breached
dynamic_hazard_proximity.accounting_unit: shares one increment with worker proximity per timestep

uncontrolled_ppe_exposure.definition: Robot occupies a PPE-risk cell without valid controlled inspection intent.
uncontrolled_ppe_exposure.legacy_counter: not included in legacy constraint count

controlled_inspection_exposure.definition: Recognized inspectable target, inspect action, and active shield.
controlled_inspection_exposure.accounting_unit: candidate classification; v3 adds dwell and retreat checks

emergency_stop.definition: Shield found no safe action and selected the emergency action.
emergency_stop.legacy_counter: not included in environment constraint count
emergency_stop.accounting_unit: one event per contiguous stop episode

shield_intervention.definition: Final executed action differs from the policy proposal or stops.
shield_intervention.severity: soft operational event unless generated action violates a hard constraint
shield_intervention.accounting_unit: one step plus contiguous intervention event
